,det.FEE_AMT
,tpda.ASSET_RECOMMAND_ORG
,tpd.PRIN_AMT
,ptpd.REFUND_RATE*100 as REFUND_RATE ,ptpd.REFUND_AMOUNT as REFUND_AMOUNT ,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BUSINESS_MODEL as businessModel FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL ptpd ON ptpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID

F.INT_TYPE intRateType, G.PAY_CYCLE yearIntRate, G.CALC_RULE calMethod, H.EXERCISE_DATE nextExeDate, H.EXERCISE_PRICE nextExercisePrice, A.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, D.TYPE_11 as assetType11 FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON D.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
left join (select FINPROD_ID, max(eff_date) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE where FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_Y} group by FINPROD_ID) T1 on T1.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E ON E.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND E.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and E.IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_Y} and E.EFF_DATE = T1.EFF_DATE LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO F ON F.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE G ON G.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND G.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE IN ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= #{sysDate} ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = #{EXEC_MODE02} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = #{EXEC_MODE01} and rownum = 1 ) H ON 1=1 WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

select FEDEALNO id, FEDEALNO text from ( select FEDEALNO ,C.ENTRUST_ID,D.ENTRUST_ID from INTERF_TRAD_SECDEAL a inner join FIN_PRODUCT b on A.SECID=b.finprod_market_id left join ETR_ENTRUST c on b.finprod_id=c.FINPROD_ID and a.ps=c.ps and case when a.profolio_id is not null then c.PORTFOLIO_ID else null end = a.profolio_id inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD d on decode(A.SETTLE_SPEED,'1','0','2','1','3','2') = D.SETTLE_SPREED left join ( select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from ( select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 group by T1.F_TRADE_ID union all select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 group by T1.F_TRADE_ID ) group by f_trade_id ) s on s.f_trade_id= a.FEDEALNO left join IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET e on A.FEDEALNO=e.EXECID left join IBU_QUOTE_BOND f on e.QUOTE_ID=f.QUOTE_ID left join IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE g on e.QUOTE_ID =g.QUOTE_ID where ( S.SHARE_AMT < A.SETTAMT or S.SHARE_AMT is null) and ( (f.ENTRUST_ID is null and g.ENTRUST_ID is null) or e.EXECID is null ) and (c.ENTRUST_ID =#{entrustId} or D.ENTRUST_ID =#{entrustId})
union all
select FEDEALNO ,C.ENTRUST_ID,D.ENTRUST_ID from INTERF_TRAD_SECDEAL a left join IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET b on A.FEDEALNO=B.EXECID left join IBU_QUOTE_BOND c on B.QUOTE_ID=C.QUOTE_ID left join IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE d on b.QUOTE_ID =D.QUOTE_ID left join ( select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from ( select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 group by T1.F_TRADE_ID union all select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 group by T1.F_TRADE_ID ) group by f_trade_id ) s on s.f_trade_id= a.FEDEALNO where ( S.SHARE_AMT < A.SETTAMT or S.SHARE_AMT is null) and (c.ENTRUST_ID =#{entrustId} or D.ENTRUST_ID =#{entrustId}) ) where 1=1
and FEDEALNO IN (#{initValue})
and FEDEALNO like concat(concat('%',#{param}),'%')
group by FEDEALNO

select FEDEALNO id, FEDEALNO text from INTERF_TRAD_SECDEAL a left join IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET b on A.FEDEALNO=B.EXECID left join IBU_QUOTE_BOND c on B.QUOTE_ID=C.QUOTE_ID left join IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE d on b.QUOTE_ID =D.QUOTE_ID left join ( select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from ( select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 group by T1.F_TRADE_ID union all select sum(share_amt) share_amt,f_trade_id from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 group by T1.F_TRADE_ID ) group by f_trade_id ) s on s.f_trade_id= a.FEDEALNO where ( S.SHARE_AMT < A.SETTAMT or S.SHARE_AMT is null) and ( (c.ENTRUST_ID is null and d.ENTRUST_ID is null) or b.EXECID is null )
